brief.title: Outpatient Appointment Scheduling System
business_goals: Enable patients to self-manage appointments online (book, reschedule, cancel)
Provide real-time, clinician-specific appointment availability online
Reduce no-shows, especially for first appointments
Automatically free up slots for late cancellations
Identify persistent late-cancellers for reception follow-up
Enable patients to request specific clinicians or book 'next available' based on clinic type
Reduce A&E walk-ins caused by phone line congestion

stakeholders.name: Dr. Fiona Marsh
concerns: Eliminate double-bookings from shared paper diaries
Enable patients to book, reschedule, and cancel appointments online
Ensure NHS Spine lookup confirms NHS number before first appointment
Comply with UK GDPR for patient data residency (within UK)
Implement audit trail for patient record views (CQC requirement)
Retain appointment and attendance history for at least seven years (NHS guidance)

stakeholders.name: Tom Reilly
concerns: Show real-time availability per clinician, including those splitting time across sites
Automatically free up slots for cancellations within 24 hours
Flag persistent late-cancellers for reception follow-up
Project must go live before the new financial year (April)
Project budget capped at £180,000 for this phase

stakeholders.name: Ben Coulson
concerns: Reduce no-shows, especially for first appointments, via SMS and email reminders
Allow patients to request specific clinicians or book 'next available' for certain clinic types (e.g., physiotherapy)
Reduce A&E walk-ins caused by backed-up phone lines on Monday mornings

stakeholders.name: Aisha Patel
concerns: Two-way sync of appointment data with existing EMIS practice management system
Achieve under 3 seconds load time for available slots, even during peak times

constraints: NHS number must be verified via NHS Spine lookup before first appointment confirmation (hard requirement from trust)
Appointment data must sync both ways with the existing EMIS practice management system
Patient data must remain within the UK (UK GDPR)
An audit trail of who viewed which patient record and when is required (CQC inspection finding)
Target performance: under 3 seconds to load available slots for any clinic, even during peak times
At least seven years of appointment and attendance history must be retained (NHS records retention guidance)
Go-live deadline: before the new financial year (April)
out_of_scope: Referrals from GPs (these will continue through the existing e-Referral Service process)
open_questions: Is the online booking system exclusively for existing patients, or can new patients use it after NHS number verification?
For which clinic types is 'specific clinician' booking mandatory versus 'next available'?

epics.title: Patient Self-Service Appointment Management
epics.goal: Enable existing patients to independently manage their appointments online, reducing administrative burden.

epics.title: Real-time Availability & Automated Reminders
epics.goal: Provide accurate, up-to-date appointment availability and reduce no-shows through automated reminders.

epics.title: Core System Integrations
epics.goal: Ensure seamless data flow and consistency between the online scheduling system and the EMIS practice management system, and verify patient identity.

epics.title: Data Compliance & Patient Insights
epics.goal: Maintain patient data security, privacy, and integrity through audit trails, data retention, and identification of specific patient behaviors.

stories.title: Book New Appointment
stories.i_want: to book a new appointment online
stories.so_that: I can secure a slot at my convenience

acceptance_criteria.given: I am an existing patient logged into the system
acceptance_criteria.when: I select an available appointment slot and confirm the booking
acceptance_criteria.then: my appointment is confirmed and added to my schedule

acceptance_criteria.given: I am an existing patient logged into the system
acceptance_criteria.when: I attempt to book an appointment but no suitable slots are available
acceptance_criteria.then: the system informs me that no slots are available and suggests alternative actions

acceptance_criteria.given: I am a new patient not yet registered with the system
acceptance_criteria.when: I attempt to book an appointment
acceptance_criteria.then: the system displays a message preventing me from proceeding and directs me to register or contact the clinic

stories.title: Request Specific Clinician
stories.i_want: to select a specific clinician when booking an appointment
stories.so_that: I can continue care with a preferred provider

acceptance_criteria.given: I am booking a new appointment
acceptance_criteria.when: I select a specific clinician from the available list
acceptance_criteria.then: the system displays only the available slots for that clinician

acceptance_criteria.given: I am booking a new appointment and have selected a specific clinician
acceptance_criteria.when: the selected clinician has no available slots
acceptance_criteria.then: the system informs me that the clinician is unavailable and offers to show other clinicians' availability

stories.title: Book Next Available Appointment
stories.i_want: to book the 'next available' appointment for certain clinic types
stories.so_that: I can be seen as soon as possible

acceptance_criteria.given: I am booking a new appointment for a clinic type that supports 'next available'
acceptance_criteria.when: I choose the 'next available' option
acceptance_criteria.then: the system displays the earliest available slot across all relevant clinicians for that clinic type

acceptance_criteria.given: I am booking a new appointment for a clinic type that supports 'next available'
acceptance_criteria.when: I choose the 'next available' option but no slots are available for that clinic type
acceptance_criteria.then: the system informs me that no 'next available' slots are found and suggests checking later

stories.title: Reschedule Existing Appointment
stories.i_want: to reschedule an existing appointment online
stories.so_that: I can adjust my schedule without calling the clinic

acceptance_criteria.given: I have an upcoming appointment and am logged in
acceptance_criteria.when: I select to reschedule my appointment and choose a new available slot
acceptance_criteria.then: my original appointment is cancelled, and a new appointment is confirmed for the chosen slot

acceptance_criteria.given: I have an upcoming appointment and am logged in
acceptance_criteria.when: I attempt to reschedule but no suitable alternative slots are available
acceptance_criteria.then: the system informs me that no suitable slots are found and offers to let me cancel or try again later

stories.title: Cancel Existing Appointment
stories.i_want: to cancel an existing appointment online
stories.so_that: I can free up my time and notify the clinic

acceptance_criteria.given: I have an upcoming appointment and am logged in
acceptance_criteria.when: I select to cancel my appointment and confirm the action
acceptance_criteria.then: my appointment is marked as cancelled and I receive a confirmation message

acceptance_criteria.given: I have an upcoming appointment and am logged in
acceptance_criteria.when: I attempt to cancel an appointment that has already passed

stories.title: View Clinician Availability

stories.so_that: I can choose a suitable time and provider

acceptance_criteria.given: I am logged in and viewing appointment booking options
acceptance_criteria.when: I select a clinician
acceptance_criteria.then: the system displays all available appointment slots for that clinician within 3 seconds

acceptance_criteria.given: I am logged in and viewing appointment booking options
acceptance_criteria.when: I select a clinician who has no upcoming available slots

stories.title: View Multi-Site Clinician Availability

acceptance_criteria.given: I am logged in and viewing appointment booking options for a clinician working at multiple sites
acceptance_criteria.when: I select that clinician
acceptance_criteria.then: the system displays available slots grouped by site for that clinician within 3 seconds

acceptance_criteria.given: I am logged in and viewing appointment booking options for a clinician working at multiple sites

acceptance_criteria.given: a patient has an appointment scheduled in exactly 48 hours but no valid email address is on file

stories.title: Send 2-Hour Appointment Reminders

acceptance_criteria.given: a patient has an appointment scheduled in exactly 2 hours but no valid mobile number is on file
acceptance_criteria.when: the scheduled reminder job runs
acceptance_criteria.then: an email reminder is sent, and no SMS is attempted

acceptance_criteria.given: a patient has an appointment scheduled in exactly 2 hours but no valid email address is on file

stories.title: Auto-Free Up Late Cancellation Slots

stories.so_that: the clinic can maximize appointment utilization

acceptance_criteria.given: a patient cancels an appointment within 24 hours of its scheduled time
acceptance_criteria.when: the cancellation is processed

acceptance_criteria.given: a patient's demographic details are entered for verification
acceptance_criteria.when: the system initiates an NHS Spine lookup

stories.title: Confirm NHS Number for First Appointment

acceptance_criteria.given: I am booking my first appointment and my NHS number has been successfully verified via Spine

stories.title: Sync Online Bookings to EMIS
stories.i_want: online appointment bookings to be automatically synced to EMIS
stories.so_that: all patient appointments are managed in a single system

acceptance_criteria.given: a patient successfully books an appointment online
acceptance_criteria.when: the booking is confirmed in the online system
acceptance_criteria.then: the appointment details are automatically created in EMIS within 60 seconds

acceptance_criteria.given: a patient successfully books an appointment online
acceptance_criteria.when: the sync to EMIS fails due to a system error
acceptance_criteria.then: the online system logs the error and flags the booking for manual review by an administrator

stories.title: Sync EMIS Blocked Time to Online Availability

acceptance_criteria.given: a clinician blocks out a time slot in EMIS (e.g., for leave or training)
acceptance_criteria.when: the EMIS system updates are processed
acceptance_criteria.then: that time slot is immediately marked as unavailable for online booking

acceptance_criteria.given: a clinician unblocks a time slot in EMIS
acceptance_criteria.when: the EMIS system updates are processed
acceptance_criteria.then: that time slot immediately appears as available for online booking if no other conflicts exist

acceptance_criteria.given: a clinician blocks out a time slot in EMIS
acceptance_criteria.when: the sync process to the online system fails
acceptance_criteria.then: the system logs the error and notifies an administrator to manually verify online availability

stories.title: Flag Late-Cancelling Patients
stories.i_want: to see a flag on patient records for those who frequently make late cancellations
stories.so_that: I can follow up with them appropriately

acceptance_criteria.given: a patient cancels an appointment within 24 hours of its scheduled time
acceptance_criteria.when: the cancellation is processed
acceptance_criteria.then: the patient's record is updated to reflect a late cancellation count

acceptance_criteria.given: a patient has accumulated 3 late cancellations within a 6-month period
acceptance_criteria.when: I view the patient's record
acceptance_criteria.then: a 'Frequent Late Canceller' flag is prominently displayed on their record

acceptance_criteria.given: a patient cancels an appointment more than 24 hours before its scheduled time
acceptance_criteria.when: the cancellation is processed
acceptance_criteria.then: the patient's late cancellation count is not incremented

stories.title: Verify UK Data Residency
stories.i_want: to verify that patient data is stored exclusively within the UK
stories.so_that: we comply with data sovereignty regulations

acceptance_criteria.given: the system is operational and patient data is stored
acceptance_criteria.when: I access the data residency compliance dashboard
acceptance_criteria.then: the dashboard displays 'Compliant: All data in UK regions'

acceptance_criteria.given: a data storage location outside the UK is detected (e.g., due to misconfiguration or error)
acceptance_criteria.when: I access the data residency compliance dashboard
acceptance_criteria.then: the dashboard displays 'Non-Compliant: Data found outside UK' and lists the affected locations

stories.title: Audit Patient Record Views
stories.i_want: an audit trail of all patient record views including viewer identity and timestamp
stories.so_that: we can ensure data access compliance

acceptance_criteria.given: an authorized user views a patient record
acceptance_criteria.when: the patient record is displayed
acceptance_criteria.then: an audit log entry is created, recording the user's identity, the patient record accessed, and the exact timestamp of the view

acceptance_criteria.given: an authorized user performs an action that does not involve viewing a patient record (e.g., updates their own profile)
acceptance_criteria.when: the action is completed
acceptance_criteria.then: no audit log entry for patient record viewing is created

acceptance_criteria.given: an unauthorized user attempts to view a patient record
acceptance_criteria.when: the system blocks access to the patient record
acceptance_criteria.then: an audit log entry is created, recording the attempted access, the user's identity, the patient record, the timestamp, and the access denial

stories.title: Retain Appointment and Attendance History
stories.i_want: appointment and attendance history to be retained for at least seven years
stories.so_that: we comply with medical record retention policies

acceptance_criteria.given: an appointment or attendance record is 6 years old
acceptance_criteria.when: I query the system for that record
acceptance_criteria.then: the system successfully retrieves and displays the record

acceptance_criteria.given: an appointment or attendance record is 7 years and 1 day old
acceptance_criteria.when: the data retention policy is executed
acceptance_criteria.then: the system moves the record to an accessible archive

issues: AC2.then says 'suggests alternative actions' — state what specific actions are suggested.
AC3.then says 'directs me to register or contact the clinic' — specify how the system directs the user (e.g., a link, a message with contact info).
reviews.fix_instructions: For AC2, specify what 'alternative actions' are suggested (e.g., 'suggests checking other dates or clinicians'). For AC3, specify how the system 'directs' (e.g., 'displays a link to registration or clinic contact details').

issues: AC2.then says 'prevents further automated processing' — this is vague and impacts estimability and testability. Specify what specific automated processes are prevented.
reviews.fix_instructions: For AC2, specify what 'further automated processing' is prevented (e.g., 'prevents the patient from booking an appointment online until manual review is complete').

issues: The scope of 'data residency compliance dashboard' implies significant underlying detection and infrastructure work, making the 'estimable' and 'small' scores borderline.
Consider breaking down the story into smaller, more manageable pieces.
reviews.fix_instructions: Consider breaking down the story into separate parts, e.g., 'Implement UK data residency detection logic' and 'Display data residency compliance status'.

issues: AC2.then says 'moves the record to an accessible archive' — 'accessible archive' is vague and impacts estimability and testability. Specify the nature of the archive and how it is accessed.
reviews.fix_instructions: For AC2, specify what 'accessible archive' means (e.g., 'the system moves the record to a read-only database accessible via a specific reporting tool').

gaps.description: There are no explicit requirements for patient authentication methods, user authorization levels (e.g., for clinicians/reception), or data encryption (in transit/at rest) for sensitive patient data, which are critical for a healthcare system.
gaps.suggested_question: How will patients securely authenticate to the system? What are the authorization rules for different user types (patients, clinicians, reception)? What are our requirements for data encryption for patient information?

gaps.description: No explicit target for system uptime or availability is stated, which is crucial for an online patient-facing service that aims to reduce A&E walk-ins caused by phone line congestion.
gaps.suggested_question: What is the expected uptime or availability target for the online appointment system?

gaps.description: There are no requirements for accessibility standards (e.g., WCAG compliance) for the patient-facing interface, which is important for a public healthcare service.
gaps.suggested_question: Are there any specific accessibility standards (e.g., WCAG) that the patient-facing system needs to comply with?

gaps.description: The term 'flag' in R-016 is vague. It's unclear how patients will be flagged, where this flag will be visible, and what criteria define a 'late cancellation' or 'persistent late-canceller' for reception follow-up.
gaps.suggested_question: How should patients be 'flagged' for late cancellations? What information should be displayed, where, and to whom? What criteria define a 'persistent' late-canceller for reception follow-up?

gaps.description: R-022 mentions 'certain clinic types' for 'next available' booking without specifying which types these are. This impacts the scope and configuration of the booking functionality.
gaps.suggested_question: Which specific clinic types should allow 'next available' booking, and which require 'specific clinician' booking?

gaps.description: R-025 states the system is 'for existing patients only', while R-011 requires NHS number confirmation 'before the first appointment is confirmed'. This creates ambiguity about the definition of 'existing patient' and 'first appointment' in this context, and whether R-011 implies a scenario for new patients or a specific verification step for existing patients using the new system.
gaps.suggested_question: Could you clarify the definition of 'existing patients' in the context of R-025? Does R-011 apply to existing patients booking their first appointment through this new system, or does it imply that new patients might eventually be supported after NHS number verification?

gaps.description: Reception and administrative staff are directly impacted by the system (e.g., managing exceptions, follow-ups for late-cancellers, assisting patients with online bookings) but are not listed as key stakeholders.
gaps.suggested_question: Should we include representatives from the reception or administrative staff as key stakeholders, given their direct interaction with patients and the system's operational impact?

gaps.coverage_note: The backlog demonstrates strong coverage for the core functional requirements, enabling patients to self-manage appointments online, providing real-time availability, and integrating with the existing EMIS system. Key compliance and data retention requirements, such as NHS Spine verification and UK data residency, are also well-addressed. The project has a clear focus on existing patients and includes mechanisms to reduce no-shows and identify late-cancellers, aligning well with the stated business goals.
